primary_audit: Reconstruct each frozen action from forecasts and locked coefficients, proposed cutoff and strict rank, and the joint binomial tests. Recompute counts and grouped point utility on confirmation and prevalence shift.
subgroup_audit: For the development-locked champion only, test the identical gate on nominal and exchange strata of gate_calibration using known simulator regime only as an evaluator stratum. Primary all-prevalence supplementary claim uses max p for both conditional risk and activity tests across both strata. No optional per-stratum cutoff or alternative selection.
margin_comparisons: Same library_depth q90 field on the same calibration and held mothers. Unscaled group max residual rank at alpha=.10, max(0, radius). Baseline 1 preselected Bayes actions; baseline 2 all catalogue with eligible minimum frozen risk, then median signed margin, then action index. Margin bands control unconditional event only under the calibration mixture. No same-calibration selective certification of these fitted baselines.
utility: Request counts, successful accepts divided by all requests, unsafe active mothers, feasibility ceiling, positive regret across frozen actions, and observed outcomes per mechanism and prevalence role.
chronology: Audit plan fixed before any calibration outcomes read by auditor. Implementation frozen by a separate source hash before any outcome access by auditor. Do not call this a new material confirmation.
